chunks.ar: عاشت قملة صغيرة في فراش رجل غني.
chunks.en_old: A little louse lived in a wealthy man’s bed.
chunks.en_new: A little louse lived in a wealthy man’s bed.

chunks.ar: كانت تختبئ بين أطراف الفراش طوال النهار،
chunks.en_old: She hid along the edges of the bedding all day
chunks.en_new: She hid along the edges of the bedding all day

chunks.ar: ولا تخرج إلا عندما ينام الرجل.
chunks.en_old: and came out only when the man was asleep.
chunks.en_new: and came out only when the man was asleep.

chunks.ar: كانت تتحرك بهدوء، حتى لا يشعر بها أحد.
chunks.en_old: She moved quietly so that no one noticed her.
chunks.en_new: She moved quietly so that no one noticed her.

chunks.ar: وفي ليلة، جاء برغوث يبحث عن مكان ينام فيه.
chunks.en_old: One night, a flea came looking for a place to sleep.
chunks.en_new: One night, a flea came looking for a place to sleep.

chunks.ar: رأى الفراش الناعم فقال للقملة:
chunks.en_old: He saw the soft bed and told the louse,
chunks.en_new: He saw the soft bed and told the louse,

chunks.ar: «ما أجمل هذا المكان! اسمحي لي أن أبقى معك الليلة.»
chunks.en_old: “What a lovely place! Let me stay with you tonight.”
chunks.en_new: “What a lovely place! Let me stay with you tonight.”

chunks.ar: رحّبت به القملة، لكنها كانت قلقة.
chunks.en_old: The louse welcomed him, but she was worried.
chunks.en_new: The louse welcomed him, but she was worried.

chunks.ar: قالت له: «يمكنك البقاء، لكن انتبه جيدًا.
chunks.en_old: She told him, “You may stay, but be very careful.
chunks.en_new: She told him, “You may stay, but be very careful.

chunks.ar: هذا الرجل يستيقظ بسرعة إذا شعر بلدغة قوية.
chunks.en_old: This man wakes quickly if he feels a strong bite.
chunks.en_new: This man wakes quickly if he feels a strong bite.

chunks.ar: انتظر حتى ينام نومًا عميقًا،
chunks.en_old: Wait until he is fast asleep,
chunks.en_new: Wait until he is fast asleep,

chunks.ar: وتحرك بلطف شديد، ولا تتعجل.»
chunks.en_old: move very gently, and do not hurry.”
chunks.en_new: move very gently, and do not hurry.”

chunks.ar: قال البرغوث: «لا تخافي! أعرف كيف أتصرف.»
chunks.en_old: “Do not worry!” said the flea. “I know what to do.”
chunks.en_new: “Do not worry!” said the flea. “I know what to do.”

chunks.ar: لكنه لم يستطع الانتظار.
chunks.en_old: But he could not wait.
chunks.en_new: But he could not wait.

chunks.ar: كان جائعًا، وكلما سمع الرجل يتحرك شعر برغبة أكبر في الطعام.
chunks.en_old: He was hungry, and whenever he heard the man move, he wanted to feed even more.
chunks.en_new: He was hungry, and whenever he heard the man move, he wanted to feed even more.

chunks.ar: أما القملة فبقيت في مخبئها.
chunks.en_old: The louse stayed in her hiding place.
chunks.en_new: The louse stayed in her hiding place.

chunks.ar: وقبل أن ينام الرجل تمامًا،
chunks.en_old: Before the man was fully asleep,
chunks.en_new: Before the man was fully asleep,

chunks.ar: قفز البرغوث فوق ذراعه وعضّه بقوة.
chunks.en_old: the flea jumped onto his arm and bit him hard.
chunks.en_new: the flea jumped onto his arm and bit him hard.

chunks.ar: شعر الرجل بألم مفاجئ، ففتح عينيه ونهض من فراشه غاضبًا.
chunks.en_old: The man felt a sudden pain, opened his eyes, and rose from bed in anger.
chunks.en_new: The man felt a sudden pain, opened his eyes, and rose from bed in anger.

chunks.ar: صاح: «هناك حشرة في سريري!»
chunks.en_old: “There is an insect in my bed!” he shouted.
chunks.en_new: “There is an insect in my bed!” he shouted.

chunks.ar: سمع الخدم صوته، فجاؤوا يحملون المصابيح.
chunks.en_old: The servants heard him and came carrying lamps.
chunks.en_new: The servants heard him and came carrying lamps.

chunks.ar: بدأوا يبحثون بين الوسائد والغطاء،
chunks.en_old: They searched between the pillows and the blanket
chunks.en_new: They searched between the pillows and the blanket

chunks.ar: ويرفعون أطراف الفراش.
chunks.en_old: and lifted the edges of the bedding.
chunks.en_new: and lifted the edges of the bedding.

chunks.ar: شعر البرغوث بالخطر، فقفز بسرعة إلى الأرض واختبأ في شقّ صغير.
chunks.en_old: The flea sensed danger, jumped quickly to the floor, and hid in a small crack.
chunks.en_new: The flea sensed danger, jumped quickly to the floor, and hid in a small crack.

chunks.ar: أما القملة فكانت لا تزال في مكانها القديم.
chunks.en_old: The louse was still in her usual place.
chunks.en_new: The louse was still in her usual place.

chunks.ar: حاولت الاختباء أكثر، لكن أحد الخدم رآها.
chunks.en_old: She tried to hide deeper, but one of the servants saw her.
chunks.en_new: She tried to hide deeper, but one of the servants saw her.

chunks.ar: أمسك بها، وتخلّص منها.
chunks.en_old: He caught her and got rid of her.
chunks.en_new: He caught her and got rid of her.

chunks.ar: لم يجد الخدم البرغوث، فعاد الرجل إلى النوم بعد قليل.
chunks.en_old: The servants did not find the flea, and after a while the man returned to sleep.
chunks.en_new: The servants did not find the flea, and after a while the man returned to sleep.

chunks.ar: خرج البرغوث من مخبئه بعد أن ساد الهدوء.
chunks.en_old: When everything became quiet, the flea came out of hiding.
chunks.en_new: When everything became quiet, the flea came out of hiding.

chunks.ar: نظر إلى الفراش الذي لم تعد القملة فيه،
chunks.en_old: He looked at the bed, where the louse no longer lived,
chunks.en_new: He looked at the bed, where the louse no longer lived,

chunks.ar: ثم قفز بعيدًا.
chunks.en_old: and jumped away.
chunks.en_new: and jumped away.

chunks.ar: وهكذا انتهت ليلته في مكان كان يبدو له مريحًا وآمنًا.
chunks.en_old: His night in what had seemed a comfortable, safe place was over.
chunks.en_new: His night in what had seemed a comfortable, safe place was over.
